explanation: The value is 0 at every D1 and GO step, and at D2 too unless the agent chose a2 and reached S2 by the common transition; reaching S2 by a rare transition after a1, or reaching S1, gives 0. On those a2-to-S2 common D2 steps it is about 7 early in the episode (trials up to about 40), 8 in the middle (about 40 to 85) and 9 late (about 85 to 99), plus 1 more (up to 10) when the previous trial was unrewarded.
